findings.reason: the claim is justificatory prose and no clause of the done-when tests it, so correcting it changes no node's deliverable or measure.
findings.text: the sentence closes "…its symmetric spectrum lies in [0, 1] and the Newton matrix is monotone", but the spectrum bound supports only the energy/demagnetising operator (I - G/mu_0 positive semidefinite, which is what the landed tests assert as reciprocal energy), not the material Newton matrix dF/dM = I - (dcB/dB)G, whose lower bound is set by the differential permeability and is not bounded by that spectrum; on the CEA curve's steep branch (215 at B = 0 to 1692 at 1 T) the differential susceptibility exceeds the secant by orders of magnitude, so dF/dM is indefinite in some modes even though the solve converges
